lines.4: 「Hurry and wake up! I keep telling you, it's morning!」
lines.6: 「Get your ass up already, you stupid taco! If you're not awake by the time I count to three, I'll make that sound of nails scratching glass, you piece of garbage! Three, two, one!」
lines.7: Ugh. It was so loud. I needed to switch it off.
lines.11: 「What you are gripping under the impression that it is the alarm switch is my hand.」
lines.13: 「What a ridiculous alarm. You will not need this anymore. From now on, I will wake you every morning.」
lines.17: I ignored her and turned my face away.
lines.18: 「If you do not rise, I will give you a light kick.」
lines.19: 「The kicks will grow progressively stronger. Eventually, you will wake.」
lines.23: 「I have disciplinary-committee duties, so I will leave first.」
